intro: Andorra is a parliamentary co-principality with two heads of state.

chapters.title: Two co-princes
text: The co-princes are the Bishop of Urgell and the President of France, making France's president the only person in the world elected to be a head of state of another country by voters in a different country. They have mostly ceremonial roles; Andorra is governed by its General Council and a head of government.

chapters.title: Andorra in Europe
text: Andorra is not in the EU but uses the euro by agreement. It has no army.

keyTerms.meaning: A state with two princes as heads of state and an elected parliament.
